judgment: It is a little good to hold firm.
At first good; in the end, disorder.
image: So the noble one thinks of trouble
lines: three years, and he overcame them.
Do not use the small person.
The eastern neighbour slaughters an ox;
it does not match the western neighbour's simple offering,

notes.name_en: 既濟 the crossing already made (濟 ford, finish); paired with 64 Not Yet Across. Not Wilhelm's 'After Completion'.
notes.L3: 高宗 Gaozong (Wu Ding of Shang) and the Guifang 鬼方 campaign — historical names kept, as in 64 L4.
notes.L5: 禴 the simple offering (as 45/46); the modest west out-receives the lavish east.
